item.title: NGC 7129 (NIRCam image)
item.description: The NASA/ESA/CSA James Webb Space Telescope has unveiled numerous stars formerly hidden by clouds of dust in a stellar nursery known as NGC 7129, 3300 light-years from Earth.

item.title: FRB 20240304B (NIRCam annotated image)
item.description: Webb observed the host galaxy of the most distant fast radio burst yet identified, a galaxy seen as it was in the early universe.

item.title: Composition of extreme debris discs across time
item.description: A team of researchers compiled the largest sample of extreme debris discs around young stars to date using Webb and Spitzer data.
